fix.notes: The `og_url` uses `request.url` rather than rebuilding via `url_for` because the matchups endpoint relies on arbitrary query-parameter combinations that would be complex to reconstruct; the raw request URL is the canonical, lossless representation. No template changes were needed — the existing `{{#og_title}}` Mustache block already handles conditional rendering when `og_title` is falsy.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

When a `/matchups/` URL with search results was pasted into Discord, the link preview showed no title, description, or summary — just a bare URL. Discord reads `og:title`, `og:url`, and `og:description` meta tags from the page `<head>` to build its rich preview, but the `Matchups` view had no `og_title`, `og_description`, or `og_url` methods, so the template's `{{#og_title}}...{{/og_title}}` block was never rendered.

## What changed

Added three methods to `decksite/views/matchups.py`:

- `og_title()` — returns `'{hero_summary} vs {enemy_summary}'` when results exist, else `None` (suppresses the OG block on the empty form)
- `og_description()` — returns `'{wins}-{losses} ({win_percent}%) — {season_summary}'` (e.g. `"39-7 (84.8%) — All Time"`)
- `og_url()` — returns `request.url`, preserving the full query-string so Discord's preview link matches the shared URL

Also added the necessary `from flask import request` import.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (no failures)

Fixes #6212
